message: 目ん玉はつながってない

Exams have wrapped up without a hitch, and the rankings are out. Everyone has mixed feelings, of course, but it's time to turn over a new leaf and give our all to preparing for the Holy Night Festival!

name: Sacchin
message: 「Heading out somewhere~? Honyanya-no-nya~♪」

Just as I'm psyching myself up inside, an airy, carefree voice comes zooming toward me from down the hall. Sacchin is riding a cleaning mop, deftly gliding from one corner of the corridor to the other.

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin, you can't half-ass your cleaning like that.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's fine~ I'm a total professional at this~」

name: Synn
message: 「Doing this at this hour means... it's punishment for getting a bad score on your exams, right?」
It's a common sight on every floor whenever exam results come out.
If you get a score that's a little too rough to make up for just by submitting a remedial report, you get stuck doing cleaning or floor waxing.
It's a strict penalty, yet overflowing with compassion. At Ryuusei Academy, failing someone outright without a second chance practically never happens.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehehe~ I accidentally wrote 'Sacchin' in the name spot on my answer sheet, and Teach got mad at me~」
...Sacchin might be a second-year next year too.

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Then all the more reason you should clean it properly, okay?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'm not fooling around~ You've wiped the floor like this before too, right, Synn-kun~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I've cleaned the floor using two rags like ice skates, sure, but riding a mop is uncharted territory for me.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh really~? It's super easy once you get the hang of it~ Wanna try~」

name: Synn
message: 「...Nah, I'm good.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh okay~ It's nice and easy, though it is a pain~ After this, I have to wax the floor too~」
...Just how low of a score did Sacchin get?

name: Sacchin
message: 「Honyara~ Just thinking about polishing the whole hallway makes me feel like fainting~ Isn't there a good trick for it~」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you know? Old milk makes a great substitute for quality floor wax. If you want, you can use my milk.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Keeping expired milk on hand too--truly what I'd expect from Synn-sama.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, you never know when something might come in handy, right? And it's actually useful for Sacchin, isn't it?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Milk sure is handy--it even gets rid of the gamey smell from liver and other offal--」

name: Synn
message: 「You sure know a lot!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe--I'm a girl too, after all--」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, I'm a guy, you know!? If anything, you could've called it "homely" or something----」

name: Sacchin
message: 「See ya--. Time for cleaning--, honyanya-no-nya~♪」

name: Sacchin
message: 「My sliding requires no brakes--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hanya~n…… Thud」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh boy……」
